name: HMIS106A_HIV_CARE_ART NCD INTEGRATION
description: This section measures the integration of non-communicable disease and mental health services into routine HIV care for clients active on ART. It captures screening and assessment, identifies newly diagnosed and known cases, tracks clients receiving treatment, and measures treatment outcomes such as disease control and recovery. The section covers Diabetes Mellitus, Hypertension, Depression and/or Anxiety, and Alcohol and Substance Use Disorder.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f

      "code": "DM01",
      "name": "DM01: No. active on ART screened for Diabetes Mellitus (DM) at last visit in the reporting quarter",
      "sortOrder": 1,
      "sql": {
        "compiled": "WITH base_pop AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id AS patient_id FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
  WHERE a.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
    AND a.diabetes_mellitus_status IS NOT NULL
    AND a.encounter_date = (
        SELECT MAX(a2.encounter_date)
        FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a2
        WHERE a2.patient_id = a.patient_id
          AND a2.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card x
        WHERE x.patient_id = a.patient_id
          AND (
              x.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
              OR x.return_visit_date > :endDate
          )
    )
),
ag AS (
  SELECT
    ag.age_group_id,
    ag.label,
    ag.min_age_days,
    ag.max_age_days,
    ag.sort_order
  FROM report_builder_dim_age_group ag
  JOIN report_builder_dim_age_category ac
    ON ac.age_category_id = ag.age_category_id
  WHERE ac.code = 'HMIS_106A'
    AND ag.is_active = 1
),
genders AS (
  SELECT 'F' AS gender
  UNION ALL SELECT 'M' AS gender
),
cnt AS (
  SELECT
    ag.age_group_id AS age_group_id,
    mdp.gender AS gender,
    COUNT(DISTINCT base_pop.patient_id) AS value
  FROM base_pop
  JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp
    ON mdp.patient_id = base_pop.patient_id
  JOIN ag
    ON TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, mdp.birthdate, :endDate)
       BETWEEN ag.min_age_days AND ag.max_age_days
  WHERE mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL
    AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL
    AND mdp.gender IN ('F','M')
  GROUP BY ag.age_group_id, mdp.gender
)
SELECT
  ag.label AS age_group,
  g.gender AS gender,
  COALESCE(cnt.value, 0) AS value
FROM ag
CROSS JOIN genders g
LEFT JOIN cnt
    ON cnt.age_group_id = ag.age_group_id
   AND cnt.gender = g.gender
ORDER BY ag.sort_order, g.gender;",
